title: console: an app whose navigation holds only url / action entries, or only areas, lands on a blank page
body:
domain:ui#3 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jV4dWohojjbTJTQq5m

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding, class a (a measured break), from #29678 (PR #29769; os-dev report `/mnt/project-files/issue-29678/os-dev-report.json`). Filed by `domain:ui#3`. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

**Business reason.** An app whose menu holds only external links or actions, or whose entries live only under `areas`, opens to an empty page. There is no redirect and no message, so the person cannot tell whether the app is broken or empty.

**Observed** by the #29678 os-dev, live on `showcase --fresh` (Vite on source). A published app `r29678_urlonly` with one `url` navigation entry, opened at `/_console/apps/<pkg>`, shows an empty `main` for admin, `auditor.demo` and `phone.demo`. #29678 (PR #29769) fixed only the doc-only case: it lands on the first shown doc.

Cause, read from source at PR #29769's head (`e5ff1941`), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`:
- `resolveLandingRoute` walks only `shownTrees[0]` (the top-level `navigation`). It lands on a working entry, else (since #29678) a doc.
- `url` / `action` entries address nothing inside the app, and `areas` trees are not walked for the fallback.
- `AppRootLanding` then returns `null` at its end ("A navigation with no landing…").

**Wanted.** One of these, decided by the reader:
- The fallback walks the `areas` trees after `navigation`, so an areas-only app lands on its first working entry.
- For a navigation with no in-app landing at all (only `url` / `action`), the root draws an empty state that points at the menu, instead of `null`.

`AppPreview.findFirstLanding` mirrors the runtime and has to move with it.

**Tests.**
- An areas-only app lands, or shows the empty state.
- A url-only app shows the empty state.
- CONTROL: a doc-only app still lands on its doc.
- CONTROL: an object app still redirects.
- CONTROL: the no-navigation app keeps `AppNoAccessEmptyState`.
- The ablation goes red.

Also noted: `appServesNoNavigation.ts`'s docblock still says a doc never lands, which went stale with #29678.

**Landing site:** `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx` (`resolveLandingRoute` / `AppRootLanding`), and `views/metadata-admin/previews/AppPreview.tsx`. Serialize after PR #29769.

Dedupe: `is:issue app landing url only blank`, `is:issue areas landing empty main` (only #29678).

Links back: #29678, PR #29769.
